meta.protocol: event-by-event walk-forward replay: before each UFC event date every model is refit/updated with data strictly before that date (per its schedule) and predicts that card; fights dated 2026-01-01 or later are never read; history rows (2019-2023) carry each model's strictly out-of-sample predictions and train only the stackers
meta.orientation: p = P(first-named fighter A wins | decisive), A as in backtest_dev.json; scoring uses the probability given to the actual winner (symmetric)

keys.fits[model]: every refit: refit_at (the card date), fit_through, n_train

market_close.desc: consensus closing line, power de-vig (data/derived/market.json p_power_close; p_novig_close if absent)
market_close.note: known minutes before the fight: a benchmark and a stacking input, never a pre-fight feature

elo.version: build_db Elo K44 boost1.5, backtest_dev built 2026-11-06T09:02:25+00:00
elo.desc: walk-forward Elo (tools/build_db.py: K 44, x1.5 for the first 5 UFC fights; tuned 2019-2023)
elo.note: sequential: each pre-fight rating includes every earlier result

elo_sig.desc: strike-share margin Elo (tools/ml.py, K and share tuned 2010-2023), walk-forward

mkt_rating.desc: market rating: walk-forward Kalman filter on earlier closing lines (tools/market.py)

ratings_whr.desc: round-level WHR (tools/ratings.py whr_rounds; params tuned 2019-2023, stream cut 2024-01-01)
ratings_whr.note: 2019-2023 rows are in-sample for its ~20 tuned hyper-parameters

ratings_stack.desc: tools/ratings.py logistic stack of its rating systems (weights fit on 2019-2023)
ratings_stack.note: 2019-2023 rows are cross-validated by year; 2024+ frozen

ratings_plus.desc: tools/ratings.py rating logits + pre-fight covariates (fit on 2019-2023)

preufc_elo.desc: Elo seeded at debut from the Sherdog pre-UFC record (tools/preufc.py; beta fit on pre-2024 debuts)

ml_lr.version: tools/ml.py logistic, 80 terms, lam 0.05, stage1 26747352de, refit per event
ml_lr.desc: tools/ml.py logistic winner model, refit before every card
ml_lr.symmetric: checked: P(B,A) = 1 - P(A,B) on every replayed fight

ml_lr_static.desc: tools/ml.py logistic frozen at its 2010-2023 fit (ml.json 'lr'): the no-refit control

ml_lr_annual.desc: tools/ml.py logistic refit each Jan 1 (ml.json 'lr_refit'): the annual-refit control

ml_lgb.version: tools/ml.py lgb {"bagging_fraction": 0.7, "feature_fraction": 0.6, "lambda_l2": 60.0, "min_data_in_leaf": 160, "min_gain_to_split": 0.0, "num_leaves": 7} rounds 250, stage1 26747352de, refit per month
ml_lgb.desc: tools/ml.py LightGBM, frozen hyper-parameters, refit before each month's first card
ml_lgb.symmetric: by construction (mirrored rows, both orders averaged)

ml_xgb.version: tools/ml.py xgb {"colsample_bytree": 0.4, "lambda": 50.0, "max_depth": 4, "min_child_weight": 60, "subsample": 0.9} rounds 300, stage1 26747352de, refit per month
ml_xgb.desc: tools/ml.py XGBoost, frozen hyper-parameters, refit before each month's first card
ml_xgb.symmetric: by construction (mirrored rows, both orders averaged)

feat_lr.version: tools/moe.py page feature LR, 60 features, C 0.01, prep b1dd5e7aa8, refit per event
feat_lr.desc: tools/moe.py page feature LR, refit before every card
feat_lr.symmetric: checked: P(B,A) = 1 - P(A,B) on every replayed fight
